DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: こんにちは。手続きの説明で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: Hello. Can I help explain any part of the procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 友人に通訳を頼んで来ましたが、友人も用紙の漢字は全部読めるわけではないそうです。話す時と用紙を読む時の支援を分けて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 友人は会話通訳ができても漢字用紙全部は読めず口頭と読解の支援を分けたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: I came with a friend who agreed to interpret, but they say they can't read all the kanji on the form either. I'd like to discuss support for speaking separately from support for reading the form.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend can interpret conversation but cannot read all the kanji on the form, and ask about separate help with speaking and reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: ご友人が読めない箇所を、推測で訳して記入しないようにしてください。特に確認したい箇所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: Please don't have your friend guess at passages they can't read, translate them, and fill them in. Which part in particular would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この注意事項です。友人は日常会話はできますが、この文章は正確に説明できないと言っています。今は記入せず質問をまとめています。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 注意事項を友人が正確に説明できず未記入で質問整理中と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: These precautions. My friend can manage everyday conversation but says they can't explain this passage accurately. I'm not filling anything in yet; I'm organizing my questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that your friend cannot explain the precautions accurately and you are organizing questions without filling in the form yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 担当に、注意事項の説明が必要なことを伝えます。ご友人には、お客様の質問を伝えてもらう形を希望しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: I'll tell the person in charge that you need an explanation of the precautions. Would you like your friend to help by conveying your questions?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい。私の質問を伝えることはお願いしたいです。ただ、友人が分からない説明まで分かったことにせず、そこで止めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 自分の質問の通訳は友人へ頼み不明な説明は分かったことにせず止めて確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: Yes, I'd like to ask them to convey my questions. But if they don't understand an explanation, we won't pretend we understand; we'll stop there and check.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your friend to interpret your questions and stop to check any explanation they do not understand rather than pretending to understand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 承知しました。別の言語での案内の有無についても、担当へ確認できます。希望する言語は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. We can also ask the person in charge whether guidance in another language is available. Which language would you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。資料があるか確認したいですが、あると決めていないので、なければ説明を受ける別の方法も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: ベトナム語資料の有無を尋ねなければ別の説明方法も相談したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: Vietnamese. I'd like to check whether materials are available, but I don't assume they are, so if there aren't any, I'd also like to discuss another way to get an explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Ask whether Vietnamese materials are available and say that if not, you would like to discuss another way to receive an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: では、ご希望の言語と注意事項の箇所を担当へ伝えます。ここで手続きの条件を満たしたとの判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: I'll tell the person in charge your preferred language and which precautions you need explained. We cannot determine here that you have met the requirements for the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人の会話の支援と用紙の説明を別に確認してから記入します。分からない文を推測で埋めず、担当に質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintJa: 会話支援と用紙説明を確認後に記入し不明文を推測で埋めず担当へ質問すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. I'll confirm the help with conversation and the explanation of the form separately before filling it in. I'll ask the person in charge instead of guessing how to complete sentences I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will fill in the form after checking the conversation support and form explanation, and ask staff rather than guessing at unclear sentences. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 注意事項の説明とベトナム語の案内について、担当へご希望を伝えます。こちらでお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-06-001-SHAR.translation: I'll pass your requests for an explanation of the precautions and Vietnamese guidance to the person in charge. Please wait here. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: こんにちは。収穫の体験で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: Hello. Is there anything you'd like to check about the harvesting experience?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この実を取りたいのですが、道具を当てる所が分かりません。隣の細い枝も一緒に切りそうなので、手を止めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 道具の位置に迷い隣枝まで切りそうで手を止めたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: I'd like to pick this fruit, but I don't know where to place the tool. I've stopped because I might cut the thin branch next to it as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you are unsure where to place the tool and have stopped because you might cut the neighboring branch too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: そのまま切らずにお待ちください。道具を閉じず、いったん実から離してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: Please wait without cutting. Don't close the tool; move it away from the fruit for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 実から離しました。太い枝を切って取るのだと思っていたので、正しい位置を実演で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 実から道具を離し太枝を切ると思ったため正しい位置の実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: I've moved it away. I thought I was supposed to cut the thick branch to pick it, so I'd like to see a demonstration of the correct position.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you have moved the tool away from the fruit and ask for a demonstration of the correct position because you thought you should cut the thick branch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 係が一つ実演します。こちらから見てください。ご自分の道具は動かさずにご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: A staff member will demonstrate on one fruit. Please watch from here, without moving your own tool.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい。見る間は道具を置きます。係の方が触れている場所と、私が切りかけた枝の違いを確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 実演中は道具を置き係の位置と切りかけた枝の違いを見たいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: Yes. I'll put down my tool while watching. I'd like to see the difference between the spot the staff member is touching and the branch I nearly cut.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will put down the tool during the demonstration and compare the staff member's position with the branch you nearly cut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 実演が終わりました。次はどの実で試したいですか。道具を当てる前に指で場所を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: The demonstration is finished. Which fruit would you like to try next? Point to the place with your finger before putting the tool against it.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この一個で試したいです。まず位置を示すので、合っているか見てもらってから道具を持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 試す一個の位置を先に示し確認後に道具を持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: I'd like to try this one. I'll point out the position first and pick up the tool after you've checked whether it's right.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will first point out the position on the fruit you want to try, and pick up the tool after it is checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 確認してから一つずつ進めましょう。後から違う枝だと気付いたら、そのまま切り続けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: Let's check and proceed one at a time. If you later notice that it's the wrong branch, don't keep cutting.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 分かりました。最初の一個を見てもらい、迷った所で止めて呼びます。隣の枝までまとめて切ろうとせず、一個ずつ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintJa: 最初の一個を係と確認し迷えば止め隣枝ごと切らず一個ずつ進めると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. I'll have you check the first fruit and stop and call you if I'm unsure. I won't try to cut it together with the neighboring branch; I'll check each one separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the first fruit with staff, stop if unsure, and proceed one at a time without cutting the neighboring branch along with it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 道具を動かす前に一個ずつ位置を見てもらう形ですね。担当の確認を待ってからお試しください。手を止めて相談してくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-07-001-SHAR.translation: So you'll have each position checked before moving the tool. Please wait for the person in charge to check before trying. Thank you for stopping and asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: こんにちは。こちらの手紙を発送されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: Hello. Would you like to send this letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: はい。家の切手を持って来ましたが、手紙から剥がして集めた物も混ざっているかもしれません。貼る前に確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 手持ち切手に手紙から剥がした収集品が混ざるかもしれず貼付前の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: Yes. I brought stamps from home, but there may be some I've peeled off letters for my collection mixed in. I'd like you to check before I stick them on.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain that your stamps may include collection stamps peeled off letters, and ask for a check before attaching them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: こちらは使用した印が付いています。新しい郵便のための切手とは分けてください。まだ封筒には貼っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: This one has a cancellation mark showing it has been used. Please separate it from stamps for new mail. Have you attached any to the envelope yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: まだ貼っていません。絵柄がきれいなので、新しい物だと思って選びました。手紙から取った切手は記念用に残した物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 未貼付で絵柄のきれいさから新しいと思ったが剥がした物は記念保存用と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: Not yet. I chose it because the picture looked nice and I thought it was new. The stamps removed from letters are ones I kept as souvenirs.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not attached them, mistook the nice-looking ones for new stamps, and kept the peeled-off stamps as souvenirs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 記念用の物は別に保管していただけます。発送に使う物については、使用済みでないか一枚ずつ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: You can keep the souvenir stamps separately. For the ones you want to use for mailing, let's check one by one that they aren't used.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 印の付いた物は、この小さい袋へ分けます。印が薄くて自分では分からない物も、未使用だと決めずにお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 印付きは袋へ分け薄い印も未使用と決めず見せると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: I'll put the ones with marks in this small bag. I'll also show you any with faint marks that I can't judge myself, rather than assuming they're unused.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate marked stamps into a bag and show faintly marked ones instead of assuming they are unused. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 承知しました。使える物を確認した後、今回の郵便の条件と必要な料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. After checking which ones can be used, we'll confirm the conditions and required postage for this mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: お願いします。絵柄の違いで料金を決めず、この封筒の内容と送り先に合わせて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 絵柄で料金を決めず封筒の内容と送り先に合わせ条件と料金確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: Please do. I'd like to check based on this envelope's contents and destination, rather than decide the postage from the stamp designs.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Ask to check the mailing conditions and postage based on the envelope's contents and destination rather than the stamp designs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 確認後、足りない分があればご案内します。保存用の袋はお手元で持っていてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: After checking, we'll tell you if there is any shortfall. Please keep the souvenir bag with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 保存用は持ち帰ります。発送用だけを確認してから貼り、不足する分の案内を受けます。次から保管場所も分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintJa: 保存用は持ち帰り発送用確認後の貼付と不足分案内を頼み今後保管を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: I'll take the souvenir stamps home. I'll attach only the mailing stamps after they have been checked and ask about any extra postage needed. I'll also store them separately from now on.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the souvenirs home, attach the mailing stamps after checking them, ask about any shortfall, and store the groups separately in future. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 保存用の切手はお手元に残し、発送用だけを担当にお見せください。使える切手と不足分の確認へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-AIZUWAKAMATSU-08-001-SHAR.translation: Keep the souvenir stamps with you and show only the mailing stamps to the person in charge. I'll direct you to have the usable stamps and any shortfall checked. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。館内でお困りのことはありますか。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having any difficulties in the aquarium?

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 魚の観察用紙を書いていますが、食べた物の欄だけ空いています。餌を食べるところは見ていません。どう書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食べる場面を見ておらず観察用紙の欄をどう記入するか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm filling in a fish observation sheet, but the section for what it ate is still blank. I didn't see it eating. What should I write?
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not see the fish eating and ask how to complete that section of the observation sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見ていないことを推測で埋める必要はありません。今までに観察できた動きはありますか。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't need to fill in things you haven't seen by guessing. Have you been able to observe any movements so far?

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 岩の陰から出て、同じ水槽の右側へ泳ぐところを見ました。餌を探していたのかどうかまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 岩陰から右へ泳ぐ動きは見たが餌を探す意図は分からないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saw it come out from behind a rock and swim to the right side of the same tank. I don't know whether it was looking for food.
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you saw it swim from behind a rock to the right but do not know whether it was searching for food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その動きなら記録できますね。食べ物については、展示の説明を読む方法もあります。どちらの情報か区別できますか。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can record that movement. You can also read the exhibit description to learn about its food. Can you distinguish which information came from which source?

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 説明を読む前に、自分で見た動きを先に書きます。食べ物は説明で知った情報として、別に記録したいです。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見た動きを先に書き説明で得る食べ物の情報と分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before reading the description, I'll write down the movement I saw myself. I'd like to record the food information separately as something I learned from the description.
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will first record the movement you saw and keep it separate from food information learned from the description. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用紙には余白があります。見た時刻も分かると、後で記録を比べられますよ。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is blank space on the sheet. If you know the time you observed it, you can compare your records later too.

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時計を見なかったので正確な時刻は分かりません。「昼食の後に観察」と書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正確な時刻を見ていないため昼食後という記録でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I didn't look at a clock, so I don't know the exact time. May I write 'observed after lunch'?
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may record it as after lunch because you did not check the exact time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自分の記録なら、そのように分かる範囲を書けます。空いていた欄はどうする予定ですか。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: For your own record, you can write what you know in that way. What are you planning to do with the section you left blank?

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「食べるところは観察できなかった」と書きます。説明にある食べ物を、実際に食べた物として書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食べる様子は未観察と記し説明の食べ物を実際の観察にしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write 'I couldn't observe it eating.' I'll avoid recording the food listed in the description as something I actually saw it eat.
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note that eating was not observed and will not present food in the description as an actual observation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら観察と説明を区別できますね。残りの見学もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-FKS-IWAKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will distinguish your observation from the description. Enjoy the rest of your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。受付で何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you with anything at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傘を二本持っています。一本は私の物ですが、もう一本は友人から預かった物です。帰る時間が違うので、別々に受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二本の傘の所有者と帰る時間が違い別々に受け取りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two umbrellas. One is mine, and I'm holding the other for a friend. We'll leave at different times, so we'd like to collect them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the two umbrellas have different owners who leave at different times and ask to collect them separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お友達は先にお帰りになるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will your friend be leaving first?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私はもう少し残ります。友人が私の傘まで持って帰らないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人が先に帰るため自分の傘まで持ち帰らないようにしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'll stay a little longer. I want to make sure my friend doesn't take my umbrella home as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend will leave first and you want to prevent them from taking your umbrella too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれ分かるように預かり票を分けます。ご自分の傘はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll issue separate claim tickets so each can be identified. Which umbrella is yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち手が木の方が私の傘です。黒い持ち手の方が友人の傘ですが、色だけでは間違えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木の持ち手が自分の傘で黒い持ち手が友人の傘だと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The one with the wooden handle is mine. The one with the black handle is my friend's, but I think we might mix them up by color alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the wooden-handled umbrella as yours and the black-handled one as your friend's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、木の持ち手の傘の票をあなたへお渡しします。もう一枚はどうしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I'll give you the ticket for the wooden-handled umbrella. What should we do with the other ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人は今、靴を片付けています。二枚とも私が持ち続けず、戻ったら友人の分を渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人が靴を片付けており戻ったら友人の預かり票を渡すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend is putting away their shoes right now. Rather than keeping both tickets myself, I'll give my friend theirs when they return.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your friend is putting away their shoes and you will give them their claim ticket when they return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。もし票を渡す前にお友達が帰ろうとしたら、受付へ一緒にお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. If your friend is about to leave before you give them the ticket, please come to reception together.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。口頭で色を伝えるだけにせず、友人の票を渡せたか確認します。私はこちらの木の持ち手の傘の票だけ持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 色だけの口頭説明で済ませず票の受け渡しを確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Rather than just telling them the color verbally, I'll make sure I've handed over their ticket. I'll keep only this ticket for the wooden-handled umbrella.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check that the claim ticket has been handed over instead of relying only on a spoken description of the color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは別々にお預かりします。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll keep them separately, then. Please enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。作業について何か確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you'd like to check about the work?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 休憩交代と言われましたが、私の作業を誰に引き継ぐか分かりません。箱を置いたまま離れる前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩交代の引継ぎ相手が不明で離れる前に確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told it's time for a break handover, but I don't know who to hand my work over to. I'd like to check before leaving the box and walking away.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know who is taking over for your break and want to check before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、どの作業をしていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which task were you doing just now?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 魚を並べる作業です。まだ一箱の途中で、終わった箱と同じ場所へ置くと全部済んだように見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一箱途中で完了箱と同じ場所では全部済んだと見えると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Arranging fish. I'm still partway through one box, and if I put it in the same place as the finished boxes, it would look as though the whole box was done.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one box is unfinished and putting it with the completed boxes would make it appear finished. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中の箱は指定の場所へ置いてください。交代する人はこちらの担当です。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put the unfinished box in the designated place. This person here will take over.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。半分だけ並べ終えたことをその人へ伝え、残りをどこから始めるか示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定場所へ置き相手へ半分完了と再開位置を示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll tell that person I've arranged only half and show them where to start on the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will put it in the designated place, tell the replacement it is half finished, and show where to resume. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引継ぎができたら私にも知らせてください。休憩へ出る方の人数を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me know once you've completed the handover. I'll check the number of people going on break.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。本人が説明を聞いたか確かめてから報告します。交代の名前を聞いただけで引継ぎ済みとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の受取理解確認後に担当へ報告すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll report after checking that the person has heard the explanation. I won't say the handover is complete just because I've heard the replacement's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will report to the person in charge after confirming the replacement received and understood the handover. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 道具も、決められた位置へ戻してから休憩してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also put your tools back in their designated places before taking a break.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 途中の箱、残る作業、道具の位置を伝えました。担当の方の返事も確認したので、引継ぎ済みとして報告してから休憩します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱残作業道具位置を伝え返事確認したので報告後休憩すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've explained the unfinished box, remaining work, and tool locations. I've also confirmed the replacement's response, so I'll report the handover as complete before taking my break.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have explained the box, remaining work, and tool locations, checked the response, and will report before taking your break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認しました。お疲れさまでした。休憩場所へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Confirmed. Thank you for your work. Please go to the break area.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。改札で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble at the ticket gate?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 交通系カードに厚い飾りを貼ってしまいました。うまく読み取れないので、強く押し付けていいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 厚い装飾を貼ったカードが反応せず強く押し付けてよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put a thick decoration on my transit card. It isn't being read properly, and I'm unsure whether I should press it down harder.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a card with a thick decoration is not responding and ask whether you should press it harder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 強く押し付けず、まずカードの状態を確認しましょう。飾りはどこに付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't press it hard; let's check the card's condition first. Where is the decoration attached?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表の真ん中に付いています。裏側を当てても反応しませんでした。カード自体を曲げてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飾りの位置と裏面でも反応しなかったことと曲げていないことを答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the middle of the front. It didn't respond when I tried the back either. I haven't bent the card itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where the decoration is, that the back did not respond either, and that you have not bent the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読み取れない原因はここでは断定できません。飾りを無理にはがすとカードを傷めるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't determine the reason it isn't being read here. Forcing off the decoration might damage the card.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、改札の前ではがすのはやめます。反応しないからといって、カードの故障だとも決めつけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: その場で無理にはがさず故障とも断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't peel it off in front of the gate. I also won't assume the card is faulty just because it isn't responding.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not force the decoration off there or conclude that the card is faulty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、こちらで確認します。今、そのカードで入場済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please clear the passage; we'll check it here. Have you already entered using this card?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、この駅から乗ろうとしているところです。入場できた表示は見ていません。確認が終わるまでここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まだ入場できた表示を見ておらず確認中は通路外で待つと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I'm about to board from this station. I haven't seen a display confirming entry. I'll wait here until the check is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not seen an entry-confirmed display yet and will wait outside the passage while the check is underway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。利用できる状態か確認してから、今日の移動方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Once we've checked whether the card can be used, we'll explain how you can travel today.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日どう乗るかと、飾りを外した後にカードを使えるかは、分けて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の乗車方法と装飾除去後の利用可否を分けて相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'd like to discuss how to board today separately from whether the card can be used after removing the decoration.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want to discuss today's boarding method separately from whether the card can be used after removing the decoration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。順に確認しますので、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check those in order, so please come this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。果物について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the fruit?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 試食した桃は好みの味でした。ただ、家で食べるのは数日後なので、今並んでいる桃も同じ状態なのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食した桃と持ち帰る桃の現在の状態を数日後に食べる予定で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The peach I tasted was just the flavor I like. But I won't eat it at home for a few days, so I'd like to know whether the peaches on display are in the same condition now.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to eat the peaches several days later and ask about the current condition of the sample peach compared with the ones to take home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 試食には食べ頃の桃を使っています。お持ち帰りの桃は、ご自宅で何日に召し上がる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We use ripe peaches for the samples. What day are you planning to eat the peaches you take home?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日曜日です。今日おいしかったからという理由だけで、一番柔らかい物を選ばないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日曜に食べるので今日柔らかい物を味だけで選ばないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sunday. I don't want to choose the softest ones just because today's sample tasted good.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will eat them on Sunday and do not want to choose soft peaches today based on flavor alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 熟し方には個体差があります。硬さを見ながら選べますが、日曜日に必ず食べ頃になるとは約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Individual fruit ripens differently. We can choose based on firmness, but I can't promise they'll definitely be ready to eat on Sunday.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付の保証をお願いしたいわけではありません。今の状態と、家で変化を見る目安を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食べ頃の日付保証ではなく現在状態と変化の目安を教えてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm not asking for a guarantee of the date. Please tell me their current condition and what signs of change to look for at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to know the current condition and signs of change rather than a guaranteed ripeness date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 香りや柔らかさを見てください。何度も強く押すと傷みますので、手に取る時は優しくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check their aroma and softness. Pressing hard repeatedly can bruise them, so please handle them gently.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 押し込んで確かめず、香りと見た目も見ます。試食の味を覚えているので、熟したか確かめるために毎日切る必要はないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 強く押さず香りと見た目を見て毎日切らずに確かめると応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look at the aroma and appearance without pressing into them. I remember the sample's flavor, so I don't need to cut them open every day to check whether they're ripe, do I?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the aroma and appearance without pressing hard or cutting them open every day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切らずに様子を見られます。食べる予定が変わった場合は、保存についてまたご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can watch their condition without cutting them. If the day you plan to eat them changes, please ask us about storage again.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は今の硬さを確認して選び、日曜日という予定だけで食べ頃を決めず、状態を見て食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今の硬さで選び食べる日だけでなく実際の状態を判断すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today I'll choose after checking their current firmness, and I'll eat them based on their condition rather than deciding they're ripe just because Sunday is the planned day.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose based on current firmness and judge the actual condition rather than the planned eating date alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの果物を一緒に見てみましょう。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's look at this fruit together, then. Thank you for speaking to me.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。入場について何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have any questions about admission?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが応援用の笛を持ってきました。周りの人が大きな声を出していても、この笛を吹いてよいとは限らないと思って確認に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもの笛は大声での応援とは別に使用可否を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child brought a whistle for cheering. I thought other people cheering loudly doesn't necessarily mean this whistle is allowed, so I came to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check permission for your child's whistle separately from cheering loudly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような笛ですか。今は鳴らさずに見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What kind of whistle is it? Could you show me without sounding it for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さな笛です。音を聞いてもらうためにここで吹かず、まず形をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: その場で音を出さず笛の形を示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this small one. Rather than blow it here so you can hear it, I'll show you its shape first.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the whistle's shape without making a sound there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この試合では笛の使用は控えてください。お子さんには、そのまま持ってもらいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please refrain from using whistles at this game. Will your child keep holding it?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使わないのに手に持っていると吹きたくなるので、私のかばんへしまいます。応援の声まで禁止という意味ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 笛はかばんへしまい声の応援も禁止なのか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: If they hold it even though they can't use it, they'll want to blow it, so I'll put it in my bag. That doesn't mean cheering with our voices is prohibited too, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the whistle in your bag and check whether cheering with your voice is also prohibited. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。声での応援はできます。お子さんが理由を尋ねたら、周りのお客様も一緒に観戦していることをお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. You can cheer with your voices. If your child asks why, please explain that other guests are watching the game together with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きな声の人がいるから同じように何でも鳴らせるわけではない、と説明します。笛を使わず手をたたいて応援したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周囲の声と笛の可否は別だと子に説明し拍手で応援したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll explain that other people shouting doesn't mean we can make any kind of noise in the same way. We'd like to cheer by clapping without using the whistle.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain to your child that voices and permission to use whistles are separate matters, and you want to cheer by clapping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それで大丈夫です。座席では周りの方の視界を遮らないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine. Please avoid blocking the view of people around you at your seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。笛はかばんにしまったまま、席で手をたたきます。子どもにも、立ち上がって前の人の視界を遮らないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 笛は収納し席で拍手して子どもにも視界を遮らないよう伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We'll clap at our seats with the whistle kept in my bag. I'll also tell my child not to stand up and block the view of the people in front.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the whistle put away, clap at your seats, and tell your child not to block others' view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは試合をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。どのような使い方のテレビをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What kind of use do you have in mind for your television?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家では字幕を使って番組を見ています。この展示画面には字幕が出ていないので、字幕を表示できる機種か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 普段字幕で視聴し展示に字幕がない機種の表示機能を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I watch programs with subtitles at home. There aren't any subtitles on this display screen, so I'd like to check whether this model can show them.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you normally watch with subtitles and want to check the subtitle function on a display model that is not showing any. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示用の映像には字幕情報がない場合があります。普段は放送番組をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Display videos sometimes don't contain subtitle information. Do you normally watch broadcast programs?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、放送番組が中心です。字幕のない展示映像と、字幕付きの放送を再生した場合を分けて確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 放送中心で展示映像と字幕付き放送の違いを確かめたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, mostly broadcasts. I'd like to check the difference between a display video without subtitles and playing a subtitled broadcast.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you mainly watch broadcasts and want to check the difference between the display video and a subtitled broadcast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 字幕付きの確認用映像を使って設定をご案内します。操作はリモコンで試したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll show you the settings using a test video with subtitles. Would you like to try operating it with the remote?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ぜひ自分で試したいです。字幕を一度出すだけでなく、消した後にもう一度出せるかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: リモコンで自ら字幕を出し消し再表示する操作を試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd definitely like to try it myself. I want to check not only turning subtitles on once, but also turning them off and then on again.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to use the remote yourself to turn subtitles on, off, and back on again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらのボタンです。今、表示を切り替えられました。文字の大きさはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's this button. You've just changed the display. How is the text size?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近くでは読めますが、家ではもっと離れて座ります。少し後ろから見て、大きさを判断してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家の視聴距離に近い後方から文字サイズを判断したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read it up close, but I sit farther away at home. May I judge the size by watching from a little farther back?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to judge the text size from farther back, at a distance closer to your home viewing distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。通路を塞がない位置からご覧ください。すべての番組に字幕が付くわけではない点にもご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. Please watch from a position that doesn't block the passage. Also note that not every program has subtitles.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-IWAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
